subject: RxJS Toolkit
description: RxJS Operators interview preparation with simple English answers, Marathi explanations and practical examples

questions.question: What is an RxJS Observable?
questions.answer: An Observable is a stream of values over time. It can emit values, complete, or return an error.
questions.explanation: मराठी: Observable म्हणजे वेळेनुसार data देणारा stream. उदाहरणार्थ API response, button click किंवा timer.

questions.question: What is the map() operator?
questions.answer: map() transforms each emitted value into a new value.
questions.explanation: मराठी: map() म्हणजे प्रत्येक value बदलून नवीन value तयार करणे. लक्षात ठेवा: Transform data.

questions.question: What is the switchMap() operator?
questions.answer: switchMap() switches to a new inner Observable and unsubscribes from the previous inner Observable.
questions.explanation: मराठी: नवीन value आल्यावर मागील inner subscription बंद करून नवीन सुरू करतो. लक्षात ठेवा: Latest request.

questions.question: What is the mergeMap() operator?
questions.answer: mergeMap() subscribes to multiple inner Observables concurrently and merges their emitted values.
questions.explanation: मराठी: अनेक inner requests एकाच वेळी चालू शकतात. Results वेगवेगळ्या क्रमाने येऊ शकतात. लक्षात ठेवा: Parallel work.

questions.question: What is the concatMap() operator?
questions.answer: concatMap() processes inner Observables sequentially, waiting for each one to complete before starting the next.
questions.explanation: मराठी: एक काम पूर्ण झाल्यावरच पुढचे काम सुरू होते. लक्षात ठेवा: Queue or sequence.

questions.question: What is the exhaustMap() operator?
questions.answer: exhaustMap() ignores new source values while the current inner Observable is active.
questions.explanation: मराठी: एक request सुरू असताना आलेल्या नवीन requests दुर्लक्षित करतो. लक्षात ठेवा: Ignore repeated clicks.

questions.question: What is the filter() operator?
questions.answer: filter() emits only values that satisfy a given condition.
questions.explanation: मराठी: दिलेली condition पूर्ण करणारा data फक्त पुढे पाठवतो. लक्षात ठेवा: Select required data.

questions.question: What is the tap() operator?
questions.answer: tap() performs side effects without changing the emitted values.
questions.explanation: मराठी: Data न बदलता logging किंवा debugging सारखी कामे करतो. लक्षात ठेवा: Observe without transform.

questions.question: What is the debounceTime() operator?
questions.answer: debounceTime() emits a value only after a specified period passes without another source emission.
questions.explanation: मराठी: User काही वेळ type करणे थांबवल्यावरच value पुढे पाठवतो. लक्षात ठेवा: Wait until typing stops.

questions.question: What is the throttleTime() operator?
questions.answer: throttleTime() limits emissions by allowing a value and then suppressing further values during a time window.
questions.explanation: मराठी: ठरावीक वेळेत वारंवार येणाऱ्या events कमी करतो. लक्षात ठेवा: Limit event frequency.

questions.question: What is the distinctUntilChanged() operator?
questions.answer: distinctUntilChanged() emits a value only when it differs from the previously emitted value.
questions.explanation: मराठी: मागील value सारखीच value पुन्हा आली तर ती पुढे पाठवत नाही. लक्षात ठेवा: Skip consecutive duplicates.

questions.question: What is the take() operator?
questions.answer: take(n) emits the first n values and then completes.
questions.explanation: मराठी: फक्त पहिल्या ठरावीक values घेतो आणि नंतर stream complete करतो. लक्षात ठेवा: Take limited values.

questions.question: What is the forkJoin() operator?
questions.answer: forkJoin() waits for all input Observables to complete and emits their last values together once.
questions.explanation: मराठी: सर्व finite API calls पूर्ण झाल्यावर एकत्र final result मिळतो. लक्षात ठेवा: Wait for all.

questions.question: What is the combineLatest() operator?
questions.answer: combineLatest() emits the latest values from all input Observables whenever any input emits, after each has emitted at least once.
questions.explanation: मराठी: सर्व Observables मधून एकदा तरी value आल्यावर, कोणत्याही stream ची नवीन value आली की latest values एकत्र मिळतात. लक्षात ठेवा: Latest values together.

questions.question: What is the withLatestFrom() operator?
questions.answer: withLatestFrom() emits when the source Observable emits, combining its value with the latest values from other Observables.
questions.explanation: मराठी: मुख्य source emit झाल्यावरच result मिळतो; इतर streams च्या latest values सोबत मिळतात. लक्षात ठेवा: Source triggers.

questions.question: What is the zip() operator?
questions.answer: zip() combines values from input Observables by matching them in emission order.
questions.explanation: मराठी: प्रत्येक stream मधील क्रमाने आलेल्या values ची जोडी बनवतो. लक्षात ठेवा: Match by position.

questions.question: What is the catchError() operator?
questions.answer: catchError() handles an Observable error by switching to another Observable or rethrowing the error.
questions.explanation: मराठी: Error आल्यावर fallback data देऊ शकतो किंवा error पुढे पाठवू शकतो. लक्षात ठेवा: Handle errors.

questions.question: What is the retry() operator?
questions.answer: retry(n) resubscribes to a failing Observable up to n retry attempts before forwarding the error.
questions.explanation: मराठी: Request fail झाल्यास ठरावीक वेळा पुन्हा प्रयत्न करतो. लक्षात ठेवा: Try again.

questions.question: What is the finalize() operator?
questions.answer: finalize() runs a callback when the Observable terminates through completion, error, or unsubscription.
questions.explanation: मराठी: Stream complete झाला, error आला किंवा unsubscribe झाले तरी cleanup callback चालतो. लक्षात ठेवा: Cleanup.

questions.question: What is the takeUntil() operator?
questions.answer: takeUntil() completes the source subscription when a notifier Observable emits.
questions.explanation: मराठी: Notifier emit झाल्यावर source subscription बंद होते. लक्षात ठेवा: Stop when notified.

questions.question: What is the startWith() operator?
questions.answer: startWith() emits the specified initial values before the source values.
questions.explanation: मराठी: मूळ stream सुरू होण्यापूर्वी initial value पाठवतो. लक्षात ठेवा: Initial value first.

questions.question: What is the shareReplay() operator?
questions.answer: shareReplay() shares a source subscription and replays buffered emissions to later subscribers.
questions.explanation: मराठी: एकाच stream चे results अनेक subscribers मध्ये share करून आधीच्या values पुन्हा देऊ शकतो. लक्षात ठेवा: Share and replay.

questions.question: What is the of() creation function?
questions.answer: of() creates an Observable that emits the supplied arguments and then completes.
questions.explanation: मराठी: दिलेल्या values एकामागोमाग emit करून stream complete करतो. लक्षात ठेवा: Values to Observable.

questions.question: What is the from() creation function?
questions.answer: from() converts supported inputs such as arrays, iterables, Promises, and other supported interop sources into an Observable.
questions.explanation: मराठी: Array किंवा Promise सारख्या supported source मधून Observable तयार करतो. लक्षात ठेवा: Convert source to Observable.

questions.question: What is the Subject in RxJS?
questions.answer: A Subject is both an Observable and an Observer. It allows values to be pushed to multiple subscribers.
questions.explanation: मराठी: Subject मधून आपण next() वापरून value पाठवू शकतो आणि अनेक subscribers ती value ऐकू शकतात. लक्षात ठेवा: Send and subscribe.
questions.example: const subject = new Subject<number>(); subject.subscribe(console.log); subject.next(10);
